call_args.rdi: out scratch in the caller (returned in rax); the caller tests the dword at +0x00 against 6
call_args.rsi: map pointer (&S+0x20 in the insert helper)
call_args.rcx: pointer to the 0x40-byte new value block

map_fields.role: control-byte base pointer; buckets are the 0x58-byte records before it
bucket mask (probe indexes are ANDed with it)
growth left: tested against 0 before the probe (grow call); decremented only when a fresh insert consumes an empty (0xff) slot
item count: the insert helper probes only when it is nonzero; incremented by 1 on every fresh insert

key_record.role: key byte pointer (bcmp target on a candidate)
key length (compared against the probe key length first)

result_variants: fresh insert: only the qword 6 is stored at out+0x00; the bucket, both control bytes and the counters are the mutation

replace (key already present): the full 0x40-byte displaced value is copied to out+0x00..0x40, so the dword the caller tests is the displaced value's own first word; the new value overwrites the bucket's value, the stored key record is kept, the incoming key buffer is freed through the dealloc slot when the descriptor's first word is nonzero, and no map word changes
counter_rule: one psubq at 0x474b973 against the constant {0, -1} at 0x450790, stored back at map+0x10: items (+0x18) += 1 always; growth left (+0x10) -= (old control byte & 1), which is 1 for an empty (0xff) slot and 0 for a deleted (0x80) slot
phases: hash: FNV-1a over the key bytes (descriptor +0x08 ptr, +0x10 len) with a final 0xff byte folded in; len 0 uses the constant hash of [0xff]; the control pattern is hash >> 0x39
grow: if map+0x10 (growth left) is 0, call slot 0x64eaf78 -> 0x4742aa0 (boundary) with (map, 1, map+0x20, 1), then reload the control pointer and the mask and fall into the probe

probe: 16-byte control groups from (hash & mask), triangular group steps; per candidate lane, bucket index = (group + lane) & mask; hit needs bucket+0x10 == key len and bcmp(bucket+0x08, key, len) == 0; matched lanes are peeled (mask &= mask-1) and the rest of the group is retried

replace: copy the bucket value (bucket+0x18, 0x40 bytes) to the out scratch, copy the new value into the bucket, free the incoming key buffer via the dealloc slot when descriptor word0 != 0, return the out pointer

fresh insert: remember the first deleted (0x80) slot of the probe; a group containing an empty (0xff) byte confirms the insertion point (the remembered deleted slot if one was seen, else the group's first special byte; if the byte at the remembered index is not special, rescan the control block from its start for the first special byte); write the key record and value into the bucket, set the control byte at the index and its mirror at (index-0x10) & mask to the pattern byte, apply the counter update, store qword 6 at out+0x00, return

unwind: the landing pad drops the value argument through 0x474ac30 (boundary), frees the incoming key buffer through the dealloc slot when descriptor word0 != 0, and resumes the unwind (tail slot 0x64df4c0 -> 0x1680cab)
verdict: The map insert 0x474b620 is the hashbrown-style insert behind the S-rooted map: it FNV-1a hashes the key (0xff-terminated, as the helper's probe does), grows the table through 0x4742aa0 when the growth-left word at map+0x10 is 0, and probes 16-byte control groups over the table at map+0x00 / map+0x08. On a hit it swaps the value in place: the displaced 0x40-byte value is copied to the caller's out scratch (its own first word is the dword the caller tests), the incoming key buffer is freed, and no map word changes. On a miss it writes the {len, ptr, len} key record at bucket +0x00..0x18 and the 0x40-byte value at bucket +0x18..0x58 of the 0x58-byte bucket before the control bytes, sets the slot's control byte and its mirror, bumps the item count at map+0x18, charges growth left at map+0x10 only for a truly empty slot, and marks the result with the single qword 6 at out+0x00 -- the variant the caller returns on without any cleanup.
